integrity: Closed-form theorem is proved for all listed parameters; exhaustive checks serve as finite corroboration only. All embedded artifacts are exact UTF-8 bytes with independent SHA-256 and byte counts.
scientific_limitations: Known erasure location, integer (not modular) sums, cyclic unit-shift full-overlap windows, one erasure, n>=3, 2<=window<n. Noncoprime claim is fiber invariance rather than a new unpunctured profile formula. No claim of exhaustive historical novelty or independent expert certification.
title: Exact capacity and ambiguity of one-erased cyclic weighted reads
